messages:
maya: kicking off a canary for release v3.2.1 in 3m, embed-service (routing + cache tuning). i'll monitor the SLO dashboard p95/p99 + 5xx. shout if you see anything.

sam: noted, i'll have eyes on alerts and traces. release notes: https://redwood.example/releases/v3.2.1 :mag_right:

deploy-bot: deploy started service=embed-service env=prod stage=canary version=v3.2.1 target=10% traffic

ana: FYI last change touched cache eviction logic, watch kvcache hit ratio and latency tails.

oliver: baseline thresholds we care about: p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 300ms, 5xx <= 0.5% (1m window).

maya: initial telemetry coming in... small p95 bump on embed-route at +2m, p95 ~135ms, p99 ~290ms, 5xx steady.

sam: digging traces, a handful show long model-serialize on host-b (~220-320ms). not many errors.

ops-bot: muting noisy infra healthchecks for +20m (/health endpoints)

oliver: metrics snapshot (2m window):
```
embed-route p95: 136ms
embed-route p99: 292ms
embed-route 5xx: 0.08%
kvcache hit: 90.8%
host-a cpu: 65% host-b cpu: 74% host-c cpu: 68%
```

maya: p95 is over our soft guard but under hard threshold. options: continue roll, pin to healthy hosts, or shrink canary. prefer pin+reduce while we investigate.

sam: agree. not a rollback. suggest `/pin-canary-hosts embed-service host-a,host-c --traffic=5%` to reduce exposure.

deploy-bot: command received: pin-canary-hosts embed-service hosts=[host-a,host-c] traffic=5%

ops-bot: traffic shifted to hosts [host-a,host-c], canary now 5%. telemetry should stabilize in ~30s.

anа: after shift, p95 down to 123ms, p99 290ms, 5xx unchanged, kvcache hit ~91%. looks like host-b is the outlier.

oliver: checking host-b: GC pause spikes in JVM logs aligning with the tail latency. pulling GC dumps now.

maya: solid catch. plan: hold at 5% until oliver tests a JVM flag bump in staging. we'll only proceed if staging shows no tail spikes.

sam: added a note to release tracker: "Observed GC tail latency on host-b during canary; holding at 5% pending JVM tuning." https://redwood.example/releases/v3.2.1#notes

deploy-bot: canary state updated: hosts=[host-a,host-c], traffic=5%, hold=true, rollback thresholds active (5xx >= 0.5% or p95 > 180ms for 3m)

oliver: prepping a targeted JVM Xmx/Xms tweak for host-b and will smoke in staging. if ok, plan a rolling restart of host-b with tiny maintenance window.

maya: agree. only resume ramp after host-b validation. if anything degrades beyond thresholds, we'll rollback to v3.2.0.

anа: tagging SRE: @sam you're primary on-call for this hold :thumbsup:

sam: on it. will post here once staging test is green or if we hit rollback thresholds.

maya: thanks all 44d i'll update PMs and the release board.

ops-bot: final: canary pinned hosts=[host-a,host-c], canary_traffic=5%, monitor_rules enforced, mute=healthchecks:+20m

maya: closing the thread for now, will reopen if we resume ramp or need rollback.
